tasksWidget.title: Notion Tasks Widget
tasksWidget.cardText: Today's Notion tasks right on your desktop. Light, fast, and no need to open Notion.
tasksWidget.metaDescription: A small Windows widget that shows today's tasks from your Notion database, so you can complete and reschedule them in one click. Free on the Microsoft Store.
tasksWidget.subtitle: A small widget that lives in your system tray and shows today's tasks from your Notion database. Check them off or move them to tomorrow in one click.
tasksWidget.windowsLabel: Windows: free on the Microsoft Store
tasksWidget.windowsButton: Get it from the Microsoft Store
tasksWidget.androidLabel: Android: coming soon on Google Play

features.d: Click the icon to show or hide it, and right-click for the menu.

features.t: Connect to Notion in one click
features.d: Approve on Notion's page and the app finishes on its own. No tokens or database IDs to copy.
Mark a task done and it updates right away. Switching between days is quick.
Move a task to tomorrow, open it in Notion, or delete it (it goes to Notion's trash, so you can restore it). Double-click a task to rename it.
Dark, light or follow Windows, with your accent color, transparency and font size.
Ctrl+N to add, Ctrl+R to sync, Alt+arrows to change day, Ctrl+, for settings.
A full right-to-left layout, plus an option for Arabic numerals.
The connection token is kept in Windows Credential Manager, and your data goes straight to Notion only.

steps: Get the widget from the Microsoft Store.
Click Connect with Notion and approve on Notion's page.
If you don't have a tasks database, duplicate the free TaskHub template while connecting and the app picks its tasks database on its own.
Today's tasks appear on your desktop.
tasksWidget.requirements: You need a Notion account and a tasks database with a Status property and a Date property.
tasksWidget.templateText: Need a ready-made tasks database? The TaskHub template is free.
